The Ottoman centre of government, in two stretches

Dolmabahçe Palace, on the Bosporus, was the Ottoman administrative centre from 1853 to 1887 and from 1909 to 1922.

info.text:
A banker's town house, dating from 1458

The core of Palazzo Pitti dates from 1458, when it was the town residence of Luca Pitti, a Florentine banker.
